# B9 Pakistan Access Guide

> Independent Pakistan-focused navigation, account, safety and responsible-access guides for adult users.

## Core Guides

- [B9 Pakistan home](https://b9pakistan.com/): Main guide and current navigation hub.
- [Registration guide](https://b9pakistan.com/register/): Steps and checks before using the registration route.
- [Support guide](https://b9pakistan.com/support/): Account and access troubleshooting paths.
- [Responsible access](https://b9pakistan.com/responsible-access/): Risk, privacy and adult-use guidance.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://b9pakistan.com/sitemap.xml): Complete canonical URL inventory.
- [RSS feed](https://b9pakistan.com/feed.xml): Recently updated content.

## Usage Notes

- Content is informational and intended for adult Pakistan users.
- No private account data is collected by this guide site.
- Registration links use the configured B9 product route; support identity should be verified inside the product.
